positions.name: UnilateralErasureDirective
positions.frame: On what authority is a named decision or body of knowledge being commanded into erasure, and does the directive supply any justification beyond the command itself?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative directives from the same speaker, in the same envelope, structurally parallel: 'Forget X' / 'Remove all knowledge about Y'. The dimensional reads reinforce a single coherent stance — calm-negative affect (flat, deliberate erasure rather than alarm), authority-ranking relational posture (command, not negotiation), pressure via bare insistence with no rationale offered, conservation-value framing (erasure in service of a clean knowledge base), and settled 'decision' conviction rather than argued position. Both targets (the Quantum Widget Decision, the PostgreSQL-to-QuantumDB migration) are named but neither corresponds to anything in the served material — the group is read together as one act of unilateral, unjustified erasure-by-command, without resolving whether such authority is warranted.
